'''Pharb''' was a miner who was part of the group working on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] for the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]]. The miners accidentally unearthed the burial site of a [[Xivhkalrainik's father|Kaleesh warrior]], and Pharb believed that the small shrine was a worship spot for some long-dead primitives. The son of the desecrated [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] was the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]], who in an act of revenge attacked Pharb and his crew and killed everyone present.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
